indication: ER-positive HER2-negative ESR1-mutated locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer
retrospective_rationale: Statistically significant Phase 3 PFS improvement in biomarker-defined population; HR 0.38 and median PFS 10.0 versus 5.5 months support clinical benefit but do not independently establish approvability
major_unresolved_risks: Immature overall survival; safety/tolerability and FDA review correspondence not yet independently assessed
